candidate.answerReason: The incircle center lies inside the triangle and is equidistant from its sides, so it lies on all three interior angle bisectors. This is choice B.

methods.label: Characterize the incenter
methods.explanation: The center of the incircle is equidistant from the three sides, so it lies on the bisectors of the three interior angles and is their point of intersection.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 9 incircle definition and the Grade 8 angle-bisector criterion.
